Frequently Asked Questions — Madinat Al Riyadh

Can I see fabric samples before ordering?
Yes, our free home consultation includes a full range of fabric samples — sheer, blackout, linen, velvet, and textured options in dozens of colours. Seeing samples in your own lighting and against your walls is the best way to choose the perfect fabric.
What areas do you serve besides Madinat Al Riyadh?
In addition to Madinat Al Riyadh, we serve Al Shamkha, Baniyas, Khalifa City, Yas Island, MBZ City, Masdar City, Al Reef, Al Raha, Musaffah, and surrounding Abu Dhabi communities. Call +971 55 225 5639 to check if we cover your specific location.
Do you sell ready-made curtains or only custom?
We specialize in made-to-measure curtains stitched to your exact window dimensions for a perfect fit. Unlike ready-made curtains that often hang too short or too narrow, our custom curtains are tailored for your home with professional finishing and installation.
How much do curtains cost in Madinat Al Riyadh?
Curtain prices depend on window size, fabric choice, lining, and heading style. A standard bedroom window typically starts from AED 500–800, while full villa packages range from AED 5,000–15,000. We provide a clear written quote after free measurement so there are no surprises.
What flooring options do you offer?
We supply and install engineered oak, laminate, SPC rigid core, and parquet flooring. Every installation includes subfloor preparation, underlay, precise plank laying, and skirting finishing. Contact K2 Curtains and Trading on +971 55 225 5639 to arrange a free flooring survey in Madinat Al Riyadh.
